name: ambiguous-workspace
title: Ambiguous Workspace MCP
description: The Model Context Protocol server for Ambiguous Workspace — exposes workspace operations (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, Mail, Drive, Tasks, CRM, Forms, Calendar, Wiki, Sign, Admin) as MCP tools. The tools array contains representative operations; tools/list returns the complete catalog. Initialization and tool listing are public, while calls require authentication. One endpoint; each tool name is the operation's OpenAPI operationId.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the current user's documents. Optionally filter by type. Returns an array of documents with id, type, title, owner, and timestamps.

starred.description: Pass 'true' to return only starred documents.

tools.name: send_email
tools.title: Send email
tools.description: Send an email from the current user. The body is written in Markdown and automatically converted to a beautifully formatted HTML email for delivery. Use this when the user asks to send an email, message someone, or share something via email. Supports to, cc, and bcc recipients. Recipients are specified by email address.

mailbox_id.description: Target a shared mailbox you hold. Omit for your own mailbox; 404 if you don't hold it.

Idempotency-Key.description: Retry key scoped to the sender and mailbox. Repeat the same key and send parameters to receive the original send; different parameters return 409. Also accepted as body.idempotency_key. The header takes precedence.

to.description: Empty drafts allowed; required when sending.

body_markdown.description: Authoring-format body. Compiles to body_html on send.

thread_id.description: Attach the message to an existing thread.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Reusing the same key with the same send request returns the original send.

from_email.description: Send-as address (must be a verified alias/domain).

archive_thread_id.description: Archive this thread once the reply succeeds.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the workspace. Pass assignee_id to filter by assignee (use the caller's user ID for 'my tasks'). Supports filtering by status, priority, project, and free-text query.

assignee_id.description: Filter to tasks assigned to this user. `unassigned` to filter to unassigned.

status.description: Filter by system status. Comma-separated for multi-select.

exclude_task_status_ids.description: Comma-separated custom status IDs to exclude.

parent_task_id.description: Filter by parent task ID. Special value `null` (string) returns top-level tasks only.

has_due_date.description: Pass 'true' to filter to tasks with a due date set.

cycle_id.description: Filter by cycle ID. `none` returns tasks with no cycle.

label_id.description: Filter by a single label ID (must be a UUID).

contact_id.description: Filter to tasks linked to this CRM contact.

deal_id.description: Filter to tasks linked to this CRM deal.

subscribed.description: Pass 'me' to filter to tasks the caller is subscribed to.

managed_coworkers.description: Pass 'true' to filter to tasks assigned to AI coworkers managed by the caller.

show_archived.description: Pass 'true' to include archived tasks (default: hidden).

untriaged.description: Pass 'true' to filter to tasks with no project_id.

hide_blocked.description: Pass 'true' to filter out tasks blocked via task_relations.
